command:
set -euo pipefail cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual TMP=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/frank-parallax-dynamic-XXXXXX) trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$TMP/test.html" /usr/bin/google-chrome --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --allow-file-access-from-files --user-data-dir="$TMP/profile" --virtual-time-budget=15000 --dump-dom "file://$TMP/test.html" > "$TMP/dom.txt" 2> "$TMP/chrome.err" || { cat "$TMP/chrome.err"; exit 7; } grep -o '
[^<]*
' "$TMP/dom.txt" echo DYNAMIC_SWEEP_DONE=1
